stories.title: What it feels like to be in the middle of Iran's widening war
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly talks with Pentagon correspondent Tom Bowman and international correspondent Aya Batrawy about the war in the Middle East for the national security podcast Sources & Methods.

stories.title: What you need to know about Sen. Markwayne Mullin, Trump's new pick to lead DHS
stories.summary: President Trump announced Thursday that Sen. Markwayne Mullin, R-Okla., is his pick to replace Kristi Noem as the head of the Department of Homeland Security.

stories.title: The first appearance of a robot on film has made its way to the Library of Congress
stories.summary: A long-lost 1897 George Melies film, arguably the first robot science fiction story committed to film, has made its way to the Library of Congress.

stories.title: Northern communities are losing lake ice as winter get warmer — and weirder
stories.summary: More than a thousand people recently gathered on frozen Lake Mendota in Madison, Wisc., for a celebration of winter. But a changing climate is affecting life above the ice.

stories.title: GLP-1 drugs like Ozempic can curb addiction risk, study finds
stories.summary: A large study of data from Veterans Affairs finds that people on GLP-1 drugs were less likely to develop substance abuse disorder or overdose.

stories.title: This week in science: Prehistoric cooking, earthquakes in the PNW, and teens' sleep
stories.summary: Regina Barber and Katia Riddle of NPR's Short Wave podcast talk about prehistoric cooking, earthquakes in the Pacific Northwest and how teens are sleeping less than before.
